newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed in all months on Friday, as the yen's weaker tone against the dollar triggered buying from individual investors in the afternoon, traders said.
Prices were 0.4 to 1.1 yen per kg higher, with the benchmark June 1997 contract up 0.9 yen at 147.9 yen per kg.
All months were weaker in early morning, but the yen's falls triggered buying, particularly at distant months in the afternoon, traders said.
The spot January month expires on January 27, and position adjustment will be a market factor next week, they said.
